en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a group of people, both men and women, posed formally in front of a building entrance with ornate doors. Several individuals are wearing traditional folk costumes, while others are dressed in clerical or formal attire. The group is seated and standing on what appears to be a decorative rug outside, and the setting looks historical. The lower right corner has the text 'Fot. Bruckus.'
